objective: Train a separate Melia model from MM imitation against the three frozen RL opponents; select only on screening/confirmation and benchmark all four exported actors against heuristics
opponentSchedule: Every six episode indices cover Nereon, Thaleia, Doreios in both starting seats; fixed policies, no self-play updates
initialization: Fresh independently initialized 128x128 actor/critic imitating MM; no transferred leader weights
selection: Highest screening outright wins, then share; independent confirmation required. Seek >50% wins against each learned opponent, then freeze before final test.
heuristicBenchmark: 100 games per distinct-leader pairing, 50 per starting seat, four general policies plus four specialist variants; no exclusions
